newsitem.title: GERMANY: Buba's Krupp says fair trade key to growth.
newsitem.headline: Buba's Krupp says fair trade key to growth.

text.p: Bundesbank council member Hans-Juergen Krupp said on Monday that global economic growth as well as improved environmental conditions all depend on fair trade.

"After all, fair international trade holds the key to economic growth and linked with that a more equitable distribution of income as well as an improvement in the environmental situation," Krupp said in a text prepared for delivery in a lecture in New York.

Krupp, who is also the president of the state central bank in Hamburg, Schleswig-Holstein and Mecklenburg-Vorpommern, added that rich nations must lay the groundwork so that structural changes, which are needed, are accepted by all.
He called for more innovation to create new jobs which will increase productivity in order to overcome poverty.
